criteria.criterion: `vloop schema list` lists state/v2, iteration/v2, session/v2, gate-verdict/v1 and metrics/v2 alongside every v1 schema, which are unchanged byte for byte.
criteria.evidence: git status shows no modification to any existing schemas/*.v1.json; internal/cli/schema_test.go asserts the full 15-name list; embed_test.go count updated to 15

criteria.criterion: schemas/state.v2.json is state/v1 with exactly these changes: a task has no `files`; a task gains `fixtures` (a string, "" when there is no gate folder); a gate_history entry gains `fixtures`; the plan gains `checks` ([{name, paths, run}]), `gate_scratch` (a list of strings) and `gate_review` ({rounds 0–2, verdict PASS, FAIL or ""}); task.model and task.effort stay {work, review}.
criteria.evidence: diff state.v1.json state.v2.json shows exactly those changes (files removed, fixtures added to task and gate_history, checks/gate_scratch/gate_review added and required); model/effort untouched

criteria.criterion: schemas/iteration.v2.json is iteration/v1 with `check_failed` added to the outcome enum and `checks` ([{name, exit, duration_ms}]) added; nothing else differs.
criteria.evidence: diff shows only title/schema const, outcome enum, checks property and its required entry

criteria.criterion: schemas/session.v2.json is session/v1 with `gate-review` added to the phase enum; a gate-review record, like a plan record, carries no `task`.
criteria.evidence: diff shows phase enum plus if-clause enum [plan, gate-review]; session2.invalid fixture / gate script reject a task on gate-review

criteria.criterion: schemas/gate-verdict.v1.json has no top-level `task`, a `verdict` of PASS or FAIL, `tasks` with one {task, verdict, findings: [{summary, kind}]} entry per task, and `notes`; the finding kinds are exactly wrong-reason, not-contract, task-reach, unpassable and pins-unnamed.
criteria.evidence: schemas/gate-verdict.v1.json: `not required task`, verdict enum, tasks items shape, kind enum of exactly the five values

criteria.criterion: schemas/metrics.v2.json is metrics/v1 with time gaining checks_ms and gate_review_ms and every per-phase object (cost, models, effort, missing records) gaining gate-review; no other key changes.
criteria.evidence: diff shows checks_ms, gate_review_ms, gate_review_usd, gate-review in models/effort/missing records and the record phase enum; no other changes

criteria.criterion: internal/schema tests validate a passing and a failing document for each new schema.
criteria.evidence: internal/schema/schema_test.go invalidAt gains state2, iteration2, session2, metrics2, gate-verdict with a schemaName mapping; testdata has .valid.json/.invalid.json pairs for each, with the invalid ones failing at a named pointer
